CSCO.rationale: Cisco shows solid fundamental health with accelerating revenue growth (QoQ +3.1%, YoY +9.7%) and strong EPS trajectory (+31.1% YoY to $0.80). The company benefits from a dominant networking position (~43% Ethernet switching share), successful Splunk integration driving software/subscription transformation (ARR ~$29-30B), and AI infrastructure momentum ($2.1B AI orders in Q2). Balance sheet is healthy with manageable debt-to-equity of 0.52 and improving margins (gross margin 64.8%, net margin 18.8%). However, valuation has expanded significantly—P/E of 32.9x is at the top of its 1-year range (25.3-33.5x), and P/B of 7.64x is also at the high end. The stock has rallied ~17% in the last quarter alone, suggesting much of the positive trajectory is already priced in. Operating cash flow declined 18.7% YoY and security segment revenue fell 4% YoY, introducing some caution. Near-term catalyst exists with Q3 FY2026 earnings expected May 13, 2026, which could provide a modest positive re-rating if AI order momentum continues, but the elevated valuation limits upside. Net: good business, fair-to-slightly-rich valuation, modest near-term catalyst—mildly attractive.
